response.justification: Bogdan has strong software engineering leadership and diverse technical experience, including real-time systems and event-driven architectures, which aligns partially with the CTO role's requirements. However, his background lacks direct experience with agentic AI systems in production, fintech infrastructure (e.g., credit systems, payment flows), and scaling engineering teams to 30+ people. His recent role at re:cinq involves AI-agent infrastructure, but details on production-scale agentic systems are unclear.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems expertise with event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby media)
Proven track record in scaling engineering teams and improving development processes (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Diverse technical stack experience, including real-time systems and high-performance databases
concerns: No explicit experience with fintech infrastructure (credit risk, payment flows, regulatory compliance)
Limited demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems or tool-augmented agents
No clear evidence of scaling a high-performance engineering organization to 30+ people or developing technical leadership layers
